t: Pipulate: Forging Computational Sovereignty with AI Magic Wands
s: Pipulate is a framework empowering developers to achieve computational sovereignty in the AI age by mastering AI tools (magic wands) rather than being subservient to large tech ecosystems. It focuses on practical implementation through refactored Jupyter Notebooks like 'Hello, AI!' and 'AI, Scrape.', enabling a personal, sovereign digital workshop.
sub: Achieving computational sovereignty with AI tools.
Pipulate's refactored Jupyter Notebooks ('Hello, AI!', 'AI, Scrape.', 'FAQuilizer').
The 'Wizard vs. Wand' dichotomy in AI interaction.
Building a personal, sovereign digital development workflow.
